current_prompt.body:
REPORT the packing obtained by applying the First Fit algorithm to the items [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] with bin capacity 10 in the given arrival order.
COMPUTE an optimal packing that uses the minimum possible number of bins for the same items and capacity.
CALCULATE the gap as the difference between the number of bins used by the First Fit packing and the optimal packing.
EXPLAIN why the arrival order causes the First Fit heuristic to use more bins than the optimal solution.
PROVIDE a self-test that verifies each packing uses every item exactly once and that no bin exceeds the capacity limit of 10.

current_plan.body:
APPLY FIRST FIT HEURISTIC TO ITEMS [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] WITH BIN CAPACITY 10 IN GIVEN ORDER AND RECORD PACKING.
DETERMINE OPTIMAL PACKING BY EXPLORING FEASIBLE BIN ASSIGNMENTS TO MINIMIZE NUMBER OF BINS.
COMPUTE GAP AS DIFFERENCE BETWEEN NUMBER OF BINS USED BY FIRST FIT PACKING AND NUMBER OF BINS IN OPTIMAL PACKING.
EXPLAIN ORDER EFFECT BY ANALYZING HOW ARRIVAL ORDER CAUSES FIRST FIT TO SELECT SUBOPTIMAL BINS COMPARED TO THE OPTIMAL ASSIGNMENT.
PERFORM SELF-TEST BY VERIFYING THAT EACH ITEM OCCURS EXACTLY ONCE IN EVERY PACKING AND THAT NO BIN EXCEEDS CAPACITY 10.
